policy_note: Tests spatial/temporal/evidence claim admission only. Does not calculate exposure, indoor temperature, hazard risk or retrofit efficacy.

cases.description: Source inventory with verified public rights.
TMY used only for typical energy-screening exposure.
TMY cannot support an observed heatwave claim.
Future projection missing scenario and period is unresolved.
Observed heatwave with exact event dates and source class.
Ward population estimate joined at ward resolution.
Ward estimate cannot be promoted to building population.
Survey sample cannot be presented as a census.
Weighted survey estimate with design uncertainty remains a sample estimate.
Boundary vintage mismatch makes join unresolved.
Partial cohort coverage is reported with the unknown share visible.
Incomplete cohort cannot support a full-coverage claim.
Qualified in-scope converged model includes thermal-service outputs.
Failed EnergyPlus process cannot support a thermal claim.
Non-converged model cannot support a thermal claim.
Model built for a different scope is not comparable.
Annual energy output without overheating output is insufficient for heat-service claim.
Calibrated, consented sensor data with allowed aggregation supports measured claim.
Expired sensor calibration leaves measured condition unknown.
Modelled values cannot be relabelled as measured observations.
Accepted intervention with installation, inspection, commissioning, pre/post and comparison evidence.
Installed but not inspected intervention is not accepted effect evidence.
Predicted retrofit performance is not an observed intervention effect.
Natural ventilation unavailable during polluted-air period cannot be claimed as cooling service.
Source rights are unresolved, so the layer cannot be redistributed.
Observed event without exact period is not a qualified event profile.
Programme-impact claim is reserved until a population-level causal evaluation contract is implemented.
